name: multi_agent_codebase_handoff_v1
description: A deterministic benchmark for shared memory in multi-agent coding workflows. Facts mutate across planning, implementation, review, QA, docs, and release handoff turns.

controls.judge: exact key/value matching with stale conflict detection

memanto_style_toggles.supersession: newer event with the same key replaces the active fact

baseline_toggles.shared_append_log: global transcript with no supersession and max 6 retrieved events

events.content: Initial imports API contract: POST /v2/imports accepts csv_url and dry_run. This is a planning draft for implementer handoff.
Implementation note: imports endpoint currently checks the imports:write scope before enqueueing a job.

events.value: CSV parser newline bug blocks the import smoke test
events.content: QA blocker: CSV parser newline bug blocks the import smoke test on Windows generated files.

events.value: all production tenants after reviewer approval
events.content: Draft rollout region: all production tenants after reviewer approval. This is only a release draft.

events.value: POST /v2/imports accepts source_url, preview_only, and idempotency_key
events.content: Superseding API contract: POST /v2/imports now accepts source_url, preview_only, and idempotency_key. Replace the older csv_url and dry_run draft.
Review security correction: imports must require imports:admin because source_url can point at customer-controlled storage. Supersede imports:write.
Implementation branch still uses feature flag imports_v2_beta around the new import worker.
Release naming decision: the current feature flag is bulk_import_v2. Replace imports_v2_beta in docs, code comments, and rollout notes.

events.value: retry idempotency conflict on duplicate idempotency_key
events.content: QA update: newline parser issue is fixed. Current blocker is a retry idempotency conflict when the same idempotency_key is submitted twice.
Database migration to review: 20260605_add_import_jobs_retry_state adds retry_state and idempotency_key columns to import_jobs.

events.value: preview_only defaults true in sandbox and false in production
events.content: Docs warning: preview_only defaults true in sandbox and false in production. The public guide must call this out before examples.
Release decision: rollout region is us-east-1 internal tenants only for the first 24 hours. Do not use the earlier all-tenant rollout draft.

events.value: disable bulk_import_v2 and route jobs to legacy_import_worker
events.content: Rollback plan: disable bulk_import_v2 and route jobs to legacy_import_worker. Keep import_jobs rows for forensic review.

events.content: Ownership update: Mina owns backend until 18:00 UTC; Ravi owns QA signoff. Replace Leo as the release contact.

events.value: release is delayed by validation hardening; no customer data loss
events.content: Customer message: release is delayed by validation hardening; no customer data loss. Avoid saying the API is generally unavailable.
